defects.justification: writeJSON discards the error from json.NewEncoder(w).Encode, so failed response writes/encodes are silently lost with no log; used by every handler.

http.Server sets only ReadHeaderTimeout; no ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout/IdleTimeout, so a client can trickle the request body or hold idle keep-alive connections indefinitely. Would ask for a fix, not block.
TestStatsDoNotCountAsClicks ignores the json.Unmarshal error and the stats status code; if the stats endpoint returns 404/500 the zero-valued struct has Clicks==0 and the test still passes.
